# yii3-mcp-audit-log-bridge

AI audit trail for MCP servers: records every rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp tools/call
into rasuvaeff/yii3-audit-log.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-audit-log-bridge
```

## Rules

- One audit event per tools/call (all registration paths: attribute tools,
  OpenAPI bridge, configurators). Failures are recorded AND rethrown — the
  MCP error envelope is unchanged.
- Arguments are masked by FIELD NAME only (AuditLogger's
  SensitiveValueMasker; not recursive): top-level argument `password` =>
  `***`, a secret nested in an array value is stored as-is.
- Call metadata change-fields are prefixed `mcp.` (`mcp.outcome`,
  `mcp.duration_ms`, `mcp.session`, `mcp.client`, `mcp.client_id`,
  `mcp.error`) so they never collide with argument names.
- WHO the event credits is an AuditActorResolverInterface decision. Default =
  the MCP connection. The connection is ALWAYS in the change set, so a
  user-crediting resolver loses nothing.
- A resolver that throws propagates: no event is written under a wrong actor.

## API reference

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpAuditLogBridge\AuditTrailInterceptor;

new AuditTrailInterceptor(
    auditLogger: $auditLogger,                             // Rasuvaeff\Yii3AuditLog\AuditLogger (writer+clock+masker)
    actorResolver: new ClientAuditActorResolver('mcp-client'), // default
    subjectType: 'mcp-tool',                               // default
);
// implements Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\ToolCallInterceptorInterface

// Actor resolvers (namespace Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpAuditLogBridge):
interface AuditActorResolverInterface
{
    // AuditActor: who the event is credited to
    public function resolve(ToolCallContext $context, ?string $sessionId, ?string $clientName): AuditActor;
}

new ClientAuditActorResolver(actorType: 'mcp-client');   // default: the connection
new IdentityAuditActorResolver(                          // the authenticated user
    identitySource: $source,        // Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge\IdentitySourceInterface (suggest)
    userActorType: 'mcp-user',      // default
    guestActorType: 'mcp-client',   // default; guest keeps the session id
);

// Bind in the application:
// AuditActorResolverInterface::class => IdentityAuditActorResolver::class

// Via config-plugin params of yii3-mcp (DI resolves the FQCN):
// 'rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp' => ['interceptors' => [AuditTrailInterceptor::class]]

// Event mapping:
// actor    = AuditActorResolverInterface::resolve(); default AuditActor('mcp-client', id: session uuid|null, name: 'client-name version'|null)
// action   = 'mcp.tools.call'
// subject  = AuditSubject(subjectType, id: tool name)
// changes  = each argument as its own field (old=null, new=value)
//            + 'mcp.outcome' ('success'|'rejected'|'error', yii3-mcp CallOutcome) + 'mcp.duration_ms' (int)
//            + 'mcp.session' (uuid|null) + 'mcp.client' (name|null)
//            + 'mcp.client_id' (endpoint-secret identity, only when non-null)
//            + 'mcp.error' (exception message, only on failure)
// metadata = AuditMetadata(requestId: session uuid, userAgent: client name)
```
